comments.body:
Alright I found some logs that may be helpful. I created a second project using Node so debugging is easier:

For Node v18.16.0, open node_modules/tedious/lib/connection.js#1040

In line 1041 add a console.log ->

In line 1041 add a console.log ->

```

connected to localhost:1433

State change: SentPrelogin -> SentTLSSSLNegotiation
TLS negotiated (ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256, TLSv1.2)

State change: SentClientRequest -> LoggedIn

```

Deno logs:

```
State change: Initialized -> Connecting
connected to localhost:1433
```

It seems there is a issue when attempting to negotiate the TLS certificate.

comments.author: participant16
comments.body:
The main problem blocking this issue is mssql terminates TLS on a duplex stream. But Deno internals only support terminating TLS on a TCP stream. We need infra to terminate TLS on any AsyncWrite+AsyncRead . To achieve that we tried to implement a JsStream struct that provides interoperability between rust and JS but it has been unsuccessful due to node internals relying heavily on the duplex being a fake net.Socket. So in Deno we need to essentially convert a duplex to a fake net.Socket that can be read/writen from rust for TLS termination.

Work by Divy/Satya
